integrity: Reproducible bit-level finite-state verification with an independent direct toggle check on \(2\le n\le6\); no independent external validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary rowmotion on labeled order ideals of the vertex–edge incidence posets of \(K_{2,n}\) for \(n\ge2\) only; no birational or symmetry-quotient claim. Formal all-parameter reduction is finite-state; direct ideal enumeration serves only as an independent finite check. Unindexed earlier coverage remains possible.
title: Uniform order 24 and exact cycle census for rowmotion on complete-bipartite incidence posets
